text:
Landing at Haneda at 11 p.m.?
The last weekday train to Asakusa leaves T3 at 23:37 👇

🚝 The Tokyo Monorail runs until 00:10.
It reaches Hamamatsucho at 00:26.

🚌 Night buses to Shinjuku: 0:20 to 2:20.
¥2,800.

🚕 A taxi to Shinjuku: about ¥9,800 at night.
Plus tolls.

🏨 Or sleep at the airport.
The T3 hotel cost about the same as town on our date.

✅ Checked bags and a late landing?
Sleep at Haneda, ride in rested.
